# THE #1 PICKLEBALL GAME
Pickleball One brings the world’s fastest-growing sport into VR with immersive courts, realistic physics, and exciting multiplayer action. Featuring **Open Play** and official **JOOLA** paddles!

[media]

Features :

● 🎮 Single & Multiplayer ( Singles, Doubles & Skinny Singles)

● 🌍 **Open Play** – Jump into continuous, rotating matches where winners stay on and challengers keep coming.

● 🏆 **Play & Earn XP Points** – Play matches, earn XP, and unlock new rewards 🎁
[media]


● 💪 **Training & Fitness** – Sharpen your skills with Training drills. Build stamina and burn calories🔥with Fitness drills.

● 🥽 **Mixed Reality Mode** – 🏠 Transform your real space into a pickleball court.
[media]
Join our community and become a pickleball legend with Pickleball One.
